result.justification: The objective is clear, focusing on long-term outcomes post-treatment of sJIA, and the methodology is comprehensive, detailing study design, treatment plans, and outcome measures.

objective_evidence.quote: The purpose of this study is to describe the long-term clinical and safety outcomes for patients enrolled in the FROST trial.

method_evidence.quote: Four consensus treatment plans (CTPs) were evaluated, including biologic (IL-1 or IL-6 inhibitors) and non-biologic approaches.
